sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase year table: a private residence is no longer marked ❌ "Brucebase event page named differently from the year page" when the year page gives its street and the event page "<name> Residence" (1949-64: "87 RANDOLPH STREET, FREEHOLD, NJ" / "Springsteen Residence, Freehold, NJ"). The wiki writes them so on purpose, to keep a real person's address out of the page's address (Danny van der Linden, 2024). BruceParser's rule: the same date and place, so "STING RESIDENCE" / "Sumner Residence" (1991-02-09) is still marked, as in BruceParser's report. 22 rows less on the whole wiki (38 → 16).
